sahneler.metin: Two minutes into a crewed launch, a Soyuz rocket failed.
Suddenly, a booster struck the core stage and the rocket began to break up.
The escape system pulled the crew capsule away.
The cause was a bent pin on a separation sensor.
It had been damaged while the rocket was assembled.
Assembly checks for these sensors were tightened afterward.

aciklama:
Soyuz MS-10 aborted during launch. The cause: a deformed separation sensor pin preventing a booster from separating cleanly.
